definitions.attempts: Recorded executor INTENT, including rejected and role-control actions; not all decision opportunities execute a tool.
definitions.dependency: Explicit declarations are candidates. Zero declaration/transfer counts do not negate implicit dependencies or establish organization fitness.
definitions.observer_cost: Capture-summary process CPU/wall/storage measurements; controller RSS is not incremental observer memory, and no unobserved baseline latency delta is inferred.
definitions.phases: First operational occurrence per T0-T6 per task; phase points are correlated within tasks, not independent tasks.
definitions.read: Explicit read_work_event/read_file receipts only; a message sent, patch published, or phase snapshot does not establish read/understanding.
definitions.success: response.ok is true; does not prove semantic usefulness, test pass, official correctness or necessary collaboration.
definitions.tests: Unique report IDs from run_tests with executed=true; read_test_result and review evidence do not create new executions.
